review_description: On time fuss free quote.Installation was neat, punctual. The installation crew was polite and they cleaned up after the install.Customer service was excellent. They provided everything needed for me to contact my electricity retailer to facilitate the meter change for final grid connection. My system is now connected to the grid.

SolarOne called me and said that I requested for a quotes online, thought they had come through your site though not on your list.  Sun Connect called me and was outright rude!!!Infinite was very professional  but lost out on price for the quality of the  system they were proposing.
